subject: Westside Watch homepage — task-aware design pass
body: Modify the EXISTING Penpot board fca4e052-7a4d-80fd-8008-8f9d0e6b9771. Do not create a new board. Inspect its actual current structure, then perform the first genuine design improvement pass. Strengthen editorial hierarchy, masthead/navigation restraint, hero scale and whitespace, integrate the 5:8 Watch Night field into the architectural grid, and turn the Chinese feature area into a coherent editorial module. Keep Living Paper #FAF9F5 and Ink #252525 dominant, First Light Gold #A2872A restrained, Watch Night #102A43 purposeful. Avoid SaaS cards, rounded panels, generic templates, decorative gold overload. Preserve editable native layers. Export this exact board as PNG and visually verify the actual result. Report limitations rather than inventing success.
design_brief: Quiet, intelligent, architectural Christian editorial publication at dawn. Cormorant Garamond English intent, Noto Serif TC Chinese intent, fine rules, asymmetry, generous whitespace, 5:8 relationships, ordered stone/paper/light feeling.
